result:
Both findings are fixed. Every required check passed in both locale modes (`LANG`/`LC_ALL` unset and `LANG=C.UTF-8`), and the new tests fail when the fix is removed. Nothing is committed yet. There are no migrations and no new API endpoints.

**F-DG2-230 (two invisible placeholder characters counted as text)**
- U+16FE4 and U+1D159 are now in the single shared "has visible content" rule in `packages/shared/src/schemas/common.ts`. The comment is updated and cites F-DG2-230.
- Shared unit tests cover each character alone, repeated, mixed with whitespace, and inside visible text (accepted unchanged).
- Integration tests: an Out of scope of only these characters returns 400 `validation.blank` at `/outOfScope`, writes nothing and adds no audit row. Visible text containing them is still accepted.

**F-DG2-231 (a NUL character in text caused an undeclared 500)**
- **Central check:** one hook that every route passes through rejects U+0000 anywhere in the body (values and keys), the query string or the path parameters. It returns 400 `validation.invalid_character` with the field's pointer. It runs after sign-in and CSRF checks, so those still answer 401/403 first.
- **OIDC callback exception:** this route declares only 302 and 429 in the API contract, so it skips the central check. It redirects with `invalid_request` instead.
- **Shared schemas:** `freeText`, `name` and `reason` reject NUL with `validation.invalid_character`. A value gets only one error, so it is never also reported as blank.
- **Web message:** `validation__invalid_character` is added in EN and AR. The archive reason dialog now refuses a NUL before sending anything.
- **Database fallback:** SQLSTATE 22021 and 22P05 now map to the same 400 instead of a 500, with a unit test. This fallback caught a real gap in my first draft: Fastify's query objects slipped past the hook, and the database error came back as a 400 rather than a 500.
- **Sweep of other places client text reaches the database:**
  - Node itself refuses a NUL in a header with 400 before any handler runs; I checked this on a real socket, on both Node versions.
  - The User-Agent is also filtered before it is stored.
  - Sign-in claims: a NUL in the issuer or subject refuses the sign-in and audits it; a NUL in name or email treats that claim as absent.
  - The full table is in the handback.

**Checks (both locale modes)**
- Typecheck, build, lint, format check, OpenAPI lint (161 operations): all pass. The format check passed without needing the variant that excludes the sandbox's dotfiles; I ran that too.
- `pnpm test` on Node 22 and Node 24: 656/656 each.
- Integration suite on a throwaway PostgreSQL (port 55471): 504/504. This includes `contract.test.ts`, `blank-text`, `oidc`, `encoding` and the new `invalid-character` suite. Every test call is checked against the OpenAPI contract, so an undeclared 500 fails the test.
- Web end-to-end tests (P1, P2 and `p2-blank-text.spec.ts`), chromium-en and chromium-ar, one worker: 58 passed.
- `validate.mjs --historical --stage DG1`: PASS.
- **Negative control** (fix removed, new tests kept): integration 17 failed, unit 18 failed. Several of the failures are the undeclared 500s.

**Gaps**
- **Undeclared 400 on GET item routes (existed before this task):** they declare only 200/401/404, yet a malformed id already returned 400. A NUL id now also returns 400. I can't edit `openapi.yaml`, so whoever owns the contract needs to either declare 400 or map malformed ids to 404.
- **E2E not extended:** I ran `p2-blank-text.spec.ts` but didn't add cases for the new characters. Web coverage is in the unit-web tests.
- **Run note:** during my first full run, a check sequence I thought I had stopped kept running alongside the start of the final run. I deleted those logs, and every result above comes from the final run, which I confirmed was against an unchanged tree.

The orchestrator still needs to record `import-findings --fix` for both findings. I haven't closed either myself.

Files are in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG2/`:
- T-DG2-BE10-backend-workflow-engineer.md (handback)
- T-DG2-BE10-evidence/ (logs)
